_meta.description: Registry for complex SQL metric computations and business formulas.

actual_volume.name: Actual Volume
actual_volume.description: Calculates sum of actual sales volume in TMT or MT.

market_share.name: Market Share Percentage
market_share.description: Calculates a specific company's percentage contribution of total market sales.

company_specific.expression: ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN {comname_col} = '{company}' THEN {sales_col} ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM({sales_col}), 0), 2)

growth_pct.name: Growth Percentage (YoY/MoM)
growth_pct.description: Computes percentage growth over previous period (month or year) using window functions.

window_lag.expression: ROUND((({sales_col} - LAG({sales_col}) OVER (PARTITION BY {partition_col} ORDER BY {order_col})) * 100.0) / NULLIF(LAG({sales_col}) OVER (PARTITION BY {partition_col} ORDER BY {order_col}), 0), 2)

sales_difference.name: Sales Volume Difference
sales_difference.description: Computes absolute difference in sales volume between two companies or two years.

company_delta.expression: ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN {comname_col} = '{company_a}' THEN {sales_col} ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN {comname_col} = '{company_b}' THEN {sales_col} ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2)

period_delta.expression: ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN {period_col} = '{period_a}' THEN {sales_col} ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN {period_col} = '{period_b}' THEN {sales_col} ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2)
